HINT_RIPPS2_MMCE_PAD_FIRST: The SD2PSX reads over the bus the controller shares, and while a read runs the pad is not heard: presses lag or go missing as covers load. On: covers come in small pieces with the pad read between them, a little slower. Off: as fast as the card goes. With the card's sources on Auto its list loads once, at boot.
HINT_RIPPS2_TRUST_CACHE: A list shown from its cache stays as it is, ready to launch from, until you press SELECT or RIPPS2 changes that source itself. Off reads each source again in the background after its cache shows, a pause you can feel on an MMCE or MX4SIO card, which share the controller's bus.
HINT_RIPPS2_STATUS_OPEN: Opens STATUS: where boot reads the settings and the game lists, which place is quickest, where a game's EXIT goes, and every drive. Its CACHE SETTINGS comes back here.
HINT_RIPPS2_BADGE_SET: The badges on a game's info page (rating, players, ESRB, video mode, scan, aspect). RIPPS2: its own set, the same on every theme. Theme: the theme's own pictures, or RIPPS2's when the theme asks for them.
HINT_RIPPS2_HINT_FADE: A button hint or glyph that changes fades in, as the covers do, the moment it changes; ones that stay are left alone, on every page and message. Off: they just appear. Theme: the theme decides (on unless it says hints_fade=0).
HINT_RIPPS2_SIDEBAR_STYLE: Classic (Split): the icons in the sidebar's dark bar with the colored strip beside it. XL (One Piece): one wider bar, the icons in its middle. Theme: the theme decides.
HINT_EXITPATH: Where EXIT in the In-Game Menu goes. Best left empty, with BIBLE set up (STATUS > Boot Loader > Manage, or BOOT LOCK on your PS2BBL): EXIT then resets the console through its own boot path and PS2BBL starts RIPPS2 as it does at power on, the safest way back. Browser: the PS2 browser. An ELF on a memory card (mc0:/mc1:) or a FAT32 USB drive (mass:/) loads straight after the reset, which not every game leaves the console ready for; MMCE can't be reached then at all.
HINT_BDM_START: USB, iLink, MX4SIO and the exFAT HDD. Auto starts them at boot: the quickest for the drives you have plugged in, their games in All Games from the start. Manual starts them when you open their page.
NEUTRINO_VMC_HDD_UNSUPPORTED: Neutrino cannot use a VMC on the APA HDD (exFAT, USB and MX4SIO can): this game starts with the real card in that slot.
HINT_RIPPS2_CATEGORY_BAR: LAUNCH DISC, STORAGE and MEMORY FILES: the names along the top, or the sidebar. Fade When Idle fades the names, or slides the sidebar away, until you press a button; it comes back at once. Theme: the theme decides.
HINT_RIPPS2_RECENTS: Recent Games, a page in the side bar with your last launched games, newest first: how many it keeps, 1 to 99 (Triangle types the number). A game whose drive is on Manual starts it when you pick it. 0 turns the page off.
HINT_RIPPS2_CATEGORY_ORDER: Swaps Launch Disc and Memory Files: Memory Files first and Launch Disc last, on the bar's names and the sidebar's icons alike. Made for RIPFLOW (Interface > Theme). Theme: the theme decides.
HINT_RIPPS2_STARSIDE: Where a starred game's star sits in the games list. Left: its own column at the start of every row. Right: after the title. Hidden (the start): no star and no column, the titles at full length. Theme: what the theme says. R3 stars a game either way; hold R3 4 seconds on a list to hide the stars or bring them back (that also stars the game under the cursor).
HINT_RIPPS2_FAST_CACHE: Each source keeps its last game list (RIPPS2.LST beside its CD and DVD folders) and shows it the moment the source answers. Trust Cache decides whether the source is read again after. Off reads every list from its source first, as before.
HINT_RIPPS2_CATEGORY_LAYOUT: Where the three categories sit: their names across the top, or icons down the side bar, each with a drawer of its pages (Left on a list goes there), or Menu: no bar at all, the categories in the START menu as on a theme made for OPL. Theme keeps the theme's own.
HINT_AUTO_CREATE_VMC: Launching a PS2 game with no VMC in slot 1 creates an 8 MB card on the game's device, named as the VMC screen suggests (shared by every disc of the game), and assigns it. Under Neutrino not on the APA HDD (an exFAT HDD works).
HINT_MMCE_MODE: Games on an SD2PSX or MemCard PRO2. Auto starts it at boot: the quickest for a card that is plugged in, its games in All Games from the start. Manual starts it when you open its page, Off hides it.
HINT_RIPPS2_TEXT_WEIGHT: How heavy RIPPS2's own text is: the Settings tooltips, STATUS and About. Normal is as it was; Bold reads better on a soft picture. A theme's own fonts keep the weights it gives them.
HINT_RIPPS2_HDD_START: The internal HDD, APA or exFAT: RIPPS2 reads whichever it is and shows it once, as HDD Games. Auto (the quickest with a drive in) starts it at boot; Off leaves it alone.
